name: Hakuchuu Misshitsu Kyoushuu-sha
source:
I, Minami Ninomiya, am a terrible driver.

I took a driver's ed course but even there I'm about to be failed out.

They're going to take my license away!

Just when all hope seems lost, my perverted instructor comes to me with an offer.

"How about I teach you privately? Because you've got nice tits. Hehe."

If I can just put up with him I'll pass! Or...?

But once the seatbelt locks in, I realize I can't escape the real lesson.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ113684?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
